description: The SWAN boiler is advertised with a heating time of 60 minutes for 80 litres, but it needs about 2 hours, twice longer than declared. The advertising is misleading and the boiler is not as described in the specification. I paid 12900 UAH and noticed the problem on 2025-09-27. The SWAN warranty service refused to replace it.
documentText: Warranty request no. 7781 of 2025-09-30 to SWAN service: heating time 118 min instead of 60 min. Answer from SWAN: no defect found, request closed.
